derivation:
rw [classifyingSpaceFundamentalGroupMulEquiv, MulEquiv.trans_apply]
  simpa [IsQuotientCoveringMap.fundamentalGroupEquiv, smul_universalGSpaceBasepoint] using (isQuotientCoveringMap_classifyingSpaceProj G).fundamentalGroupToMulOpposite_apply_mk_eq (g := g⁻¹) hΓ (by simpa using hΓ₀) (by simpa using hΓ₁)
explanation: Mathlib’s theorem identifies the fundamental-group-to-opposite-group map with the group element whose translate of the chosen fiber point is the lifted path’s endpoint. Specialize it to the classifying-space quotient covering map and to g⁻¹; the basepoint translation gives the stated vertex, and composing with the inverse equivalence yields g. The current proof instead uses the classifying-space iff theorem and the generic monodromy endpoint lemma.
